title: TITLE: CENTRE THE LINE
why: The critic: the line sat left at x=435 while the stack is centred on 960 (P0), and was the boldest text under the logo. Centred, 20px, quieter.
now: The title line is centred and quieter.

edits.anchor: #root #title #titletag{ margin:24px 0 16px; font:700 var(--fs-title)/1.1 var(--f-cond); letter-spacing:var(--track); color:var(--tx-1); }
edits.replacement: #root #title #titletag{ margin:24px auto 16px; text-align:center; font:600 var(--fs-body)/1.1 var(--f-cond); letter-spacing:var(--track); color:var(--tx-2); }   /* v28.xx (cw-title-centre), the critic (2 of 5, P0): "left-aligned at x=435 while everything else is centred on 960; the boldest text under the logo, it competes with the title". Centred (auto margins, 24px above and 16px below), 20px in tx-2 so the logo and 1 player lead. */
